# 1309. Decrypt String from Alphabet to Integer Mapping

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def freqAlphabets(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        ans = ""
        n = len(s)
        p = 0
        while p < n:
            if p + 2 < n and s[p + 2] == "#":
                ans += chr(ord('j') + int(s[p: p + 2]) - 10)
                p += 3
            else:
                ans += chr(ord('a') + int(s[p]) - 1)
                p += 1
        return ans
```
